name: BibleStudy
subtitle: Bible study for the iPhone
description: BibleStudy for the iPhone: read, search, mark, take notes and prepare Bible studies. Free, open source. Installed with SideStore.

apps.name: BibleStudy
apps.subtitle: Bible study for the iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Read the Bible in several translations, search it, mark words, take notes, write documents and prepare Bible studies. Your data stays on your phone. Beta: the iPhone version is new, please report what does not work.

## New in 1.9.14
**Kind of update:** Feature
- **[Feature]** **See each other live while studying together:** when you both read the same chapter, the verses the other person clicks get a purple frame with their name, and their mouse pointer moves over your text. You also see when they are typing. Can be switched off with "Show my mouse pointer".
- **[Feature]** **Share more:** highlights of the chosen verses, the chapter, the book or all of them; notes of the chapter, the book or all of them; and a copy of a whole vault, which the other person can view as a guest or save as a new vault. Takin

## New in 1.9.13
**Kind of update:** Feature
- **[Feature]** **Study together without codes in the same network:** on the same Wi-Fi or in the same ZeroTier or Tailscale network you see each other by name on the "Study together" page. Tap the name, the other person accepts, and you are connected directly and encrypted. Both see a check number; if it matches, nobody is in between. If nobody shows up, connect by typing the other person's address. The codes are still there for people in different networks.
